lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately nine discernible vertical columns along the lateral flank. Within each column, blobs exhibit semi-regular vertical spacing, with a higher density of clusters observed in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement where the blobs serve as high-intensity nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-based low-intensity pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) near the posterior-ventral margin of the pectoral fin at the bottom of the frame.
